description: Source code implementing tree-walking and tree entry decoding for Git's internal storage, including functions for initializing, updating, and traversing tree descriptors, handling symlinks, and filtering entries based on pathspecs.

classes.name: tree_desc
classes.description: Represents a descriptor for a git tree, including its buffer, size, algorithm, and associated object id.

classes.name: tree_desc_skip
classes.description: Linked list node for skipping over already processed tree entries during extended traversal.

classes.name: tree_desc_x
classes.description: Extends tree_desc with additional skipping information for extended traversal logic.

classes.name: dir_state
classes.description: Holds information about a directory's tree object, its size, and oid during traversal.

methods.name: int decode_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,const char * buf,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Decodes a tree entry from a buffer into a tree_desc structure, handling errors for malformed entries.

methods.name: int init_tree_desc_internal(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err,enum tree_desc_flags flags)
methods.description: Initializes a tree descriptor with a given buffer and object id, decoding the first entry.

methods.name: void init_tree_desc(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Initializes a tree descriptor and dies on error.

methods.name: int init_tree_desc_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size,enum tree_desc_flags flags)
methods.description: Escalates initialization errors into error messages instead of dying.

methods.name: void * fill_tree_descriptor(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the repository and initializes a descriptor with its data.

methods.name: int update_tree_entry_internal(struct tree_desc * desc,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Updates a tree descriptor to point to the next entry, decoding and removing the previous one.

methods.name: void update_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc)
methods.description: Updates a tree descriptor, dying on error.

methods.name: int update_tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc)
methods.description: Updates a tree descriptor, returning an error instead of dying.

methods.name: int tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Retrieves the current tree entry and advances the descriptor.

methods.name: int tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Retrieves the current tree entry and advances the descriptor, but can return 0 on errors.

methods.name: int traverse_trees(struct index_state * istate,int n,struct tree_desc * t,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Recursively traverses multiple trees applying a callback to matching entries, considering pathspecs.

methods.name: int get_tree_entry(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * name,struct object_id * oid,unsigned short * mode)
methods.description: Looks up a tree object by name within another tree's object id.

methods.name: enum:get_oid_result get_tree_entry_follow_symlinks(struct repository * r,struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * name,struct object_id * result,struct strbuf * result_path,unsigned short * mode)
methods.description: Finds a tree entry, following symlinks, possibly across repository boundaries, with symlink depth limit.
